question: Did dental revenue grow from Q2 to Q3 2026? Show both quarters.
sql:
SELECT 
    CASE WHEN h.inv_dt < '2026-07-01' THEN '2026-Q2' ELSE '2026-Q3' END AS quarter,
    ROUND(SUM(l.ext_amt_c) / 100.0, 2) AS dental_revenue
FROM 
    inv_line l 
JOIN 
    inv_hdr h ON h.inv_id = l.inv_id
WHERE 
    h.status_cd = 'P' 
    AND h.src_sys <> 'legacy_pos' 
    AND l.cat_cd IN ('DENT', 'DNT') 
    AND h.inv_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY 
    quarter 
ORDER BY 
    quarter
